location_exception_reason: Prefabricated shelters are factory-manufactured, standardised modular structures. Buyer decision is driven by technical specs (panel type, insulation, load rating, dimensions), application (telecom/defence/labour), and compliance (IS:875, IS:1893), not origin location. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor, etc.) already exposes business relationship independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a shelter title leaves the product definition complete and unchanged; the business type is metadata, not a product attribute.
